name: Tenten
source:
Tenten is a kunoichi from Konohagakure. Tenten has dark brown hair and brown eye. She wears her hair in two Chinese-style buns on her head with with short fringe-bangs covering her forehead. Over the years, Tenten's hobby of collecting every type of ninja tool from across the world escalated to the point she opened a shop to sell the tools, though it's nearly always empty due to the peaceful era.

[In game description]
